g.text: py-app-sticker-terminal-partnermerken | type sticker | trim 104.97 x 30.61 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 22 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 104.97 x 30.61 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 110.97 x 36.61 mm.
Variabelen: badges = easypark, parkbee, myway, mobian

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has only a 0.25 pt hairline as die line, no ThruCut contour. Radius measured on the die line, to be confirmed by the printer.

Four square navy badges (20.6 mm, radius 22 percent) with EasyPark, ParkBee, MyWay and Mobian, composed from py-atom-badge-square-navy and the third party partner atoms (reference only, source the official files). Order on the sheet: EasyPark, ParkBee, MyWay, Mobian. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no

trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
